functions.name: CONVERT
functions.description: Converts a number between units with an exact factor. A unit that is unknown or ambiguous is an error, never a guess.

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: The number to convert.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Unit to convert from, for example km/h.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Unit to convert to, for example m/s.

parameters.name: density
parameters.description: Optional, only for mass to volume (or back): your own density, for example 998.2067kg/m3, or the name of a density in a loaded config such as water_25C (needs config water). Ignored when no density is needed. Nothing is assumed when it is left out.

parameters.name: config
parameters.description: Optional: a shipped config that resolves names which are otherwise refused as ambiguous, for example us-customary (ton, mile, gal), us-survey, imperial, metric-trade, year-julian, year-civil, or water for its densities. Several: us-customary,water.

functions.name: CONVERTEXACT
functions.description: Like CONVERT, but the value may be text with pi, kept exact: "4pi", "pi/2", "2*pi^2", or a decimal such as "0.1". Allows * / ^ and parentheses, no addition. Rounded once at the end. A unit or expression that is unknown or ambiguous is an error, never a guess.

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: The value to convert: a number, or text such as "4pi" or "pi/2". Write 1/(2*pi), not 1/2pi (ambiguous, refused).

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Unit to convert from, for example rad.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Unit to convert to, for example deg.

parameters.name: density
parameters.description: Optional, only for mass to volume (or back): your own density, for example 998.2067kg/m3, or the name of a density in a loaded config such as water_25C (needs config water). Ignored when no density is needed. Nothing is assumed when it is left out.

parameters.name: config
parameters.description: Optional: a shipped config that resolves names which are otherwise refused as ambiguous, for example us-customary (ton, mile, gal), us-survey, imperial, metric-trade, year-julian, year-civil, or water for its densities. Several: us-customary,water.

functions.name: CONVERTRANGE
functions.description: Converts every number in a range between units with one exact factor, and spills the results. Blank cells stay blank; a cell with text is an error that names its position. A unit that is unknown or ambiguous is an error, never a guess.

parameters.name: values
parameters.description: The range of numbers to convert. Blank cells (or cells with only spaces) stay blank.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Unit to convert from, for example km/h.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Unit to convert to, for example m/s.

parameters.name: density
parameters.description: Optional, only for mass to volume (or back): your own density, for example 998.2067kg/m3, or the name of a density in a loaded config such as water_25C (needs config water). Ignored when no density is needed. Nothing is assumed when it is left out.

parameters.name: config
parameters.description: Optional: a shipped config that resolves names which are otherwise refused as ambiguous, for example us-customary (ton, mile, gal), us-survey, imperial, metric-trade, year-julian, year-civil, or water for its densities. Several: us-customary,water.

functions.name: CALC
functions.description: Evaluates an equation with units and returns the number in the unit you ask for. Exact where the mathematics is exact. The unit is required and checked: a result of another dimension is an error, never a guess.

parameters.name: expression
parameters.description: The equation, for example sqrt(2 * dp / rho) or 2 kip/ft * (20 ft)^2 / 8. Put a space on both sides of an operator between quantities.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: The unit of the result, for example m/s or kN*m.

parameters.name: variables
parameters.description: Optional: values for names in the equation as name=value entries separated by ;, for example dp=50 kPa; rho=998 kg/m3. Build them from cells with &.

parameters.name: config
parameters.description: Optional: a shipped config that resolves names which are otherwise refused as ambiguous, for example us-customary.

functions.name: CALCTEXT
functions.description: Evaluates an equation with units and returns the result as text with its unit, for example 1.5 km. An approximate result starts with ≈ and a rounded exact result ends with …. The unit is the one the arithmetic gave unless you give one.

parameters.name: expression
parameters.description: The equation, for example sqrt(2 m2) or n * molar_gas_constant * T.to(K) / V.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Optional: the unit of the result. Leave it out to keep the unit the arithmetic gave.

parameters.name: variables
parameters.description: Optional: values for names as name=value entries separated by ;.

parameters.name: config
parameters.description: Optional: a shipped config, for example us-customary.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: Optional words separated by spaces: sci (scientific notation), sci=4 (4 significant digits), autoprefix (the SI prefix that suits the number, 1500 m is 1.5 km, not with a unit), exact (add the exact fraction).

functions.name: VERSION
functions.description: The unit table version and the number of units.
